name: anlide/hilos-demo-chat
description: Real-time chat with WebSocket and enhanced capabilities demo project for Hilos v2 framework

scripts.setup-env: docker-compose -f docker/docker-compose.local.yml run --rm chat-cli-local sh -c "if [ ! -f ../.env ] && [ -f ../.env.example ]; then cp ../.env.example ../.env && echo '.env file created from .env.example'; else echo '.env file already exists or .env.example not found'; fi"
scripts.install-deps: docker-compose -f docker/docker-compose.local.yml run --rm chat-cli-local composer install
scripts.ollama-pull: docker-compose -f docker/docker-compose.local.yml exec -T ollama-local ollama pull qwen2.5:0.5b && docker-compose -f docker/docker-compose.local.yml exec -T ollama-local ollama pull qwen2.5:3b && docker-compose -f docker/docker-compose.local.yml exec -T ollama-local ollama pull qwen2.5:7b
scripts.ollama-pull-gpu-nvidia: docker-compose -f docker/docker-compose.local.yml -f docker/docker-compose.local.gpu-nvidia.yml exec -T ollama-local ollama pull qwen2.5:0.5b && docker-compose -f docker/docker-compose.local.yml -f docker/docker-compose.local.gpu-nvidia.yml exec -T ollama-local ollama pull qwen2.5:3b && docker-compose -f docker/docker-compose.local.yml -f docker/docker-compose.local.gpu-nvidia.yml exec -T ollama-local ollama pull qwen2.5:7b
scripts.ollama-pull-gpu-amd: docker-compose -f docker/docker-compose.local.yml -f docker/docker-compose.local.gpu-amd.yml exec -T ollama-local ollama pull qwen2.5:0.5b && docker-compose -f docker/docker-compose.local.yml -f docker/docker-compose.local.gpu-amd.yml exec -T ollama-local ollama pull qwen2.5:3b && docker-compose -f docker/docker-compose.local.yml -f docker/docker-compose.local.gpu-amd.yml exec -T ollama-local ollama pull qwen2.5:7b
scripts.daemon-status: docker-compose -f docker/docker-compose.local.yml run --rm chat-cli-local php backend/Bootstrap/cli.php daemon:status
scripts.daemon-monitor: docker-compose -f docker/docker-compose.local.yml run --rm chat-cli-local php backend/Bootstrap/cli.php daemon:monitor
scripts.cli: docker-compose -f docker/docker-compose.local.yml run --rm chat-cli-local php backend/Bootstrap/cli.php
scripts.migration:up: docker-compose -f docker/docker-compose.local.yml run --rm chat-cli-local php backend/Bootstrap/cli.php migration:up
scripts.migration:down: docker-compose -f docker/docker-compose.local.yml run --rm chat-cli-local php backend/Bootstrap/cli.php migration:down
scripts.migration:status: docker-compose -f docker/docker-compose.local.yml run --rm chat-cli-local php backend/Bootstrap/cli.php migration:status
scripts.migration:retry: docker-compose -f docker/docker-compose.local.yml run --rm chat-cli-local php backend/Bootstrap/cli.php migration:retry
scripts.seed:apply: docker-compose -f docker/docker-compose.local.yml run --rm chat-cli-local php backend/Bootstrap/cli.php seed:apply
scripts.db:schema:status: docker-compose -f docker/docker-compose.local.yml run --rm chat-cli-local php backend/Bootstrap/cli.php db:schema:status
scripts.db:entity:diff: docker-compose -f docker/docker-compose.local.yml run --rm chat-cli-local php backend/Bootstrap/cli.php db:entity:diff
scripts.db:entity:fix: docker-compose -f docker/docker-compose.local.yml run --rm chat-cli-local php backend/Bootstrap/cli.php db:entity:fix
scripts.db:entity:fix-dry-run: docker-compose -f docker/docker-compose.local.yml run --rm chat-cli-local php backend/Bootstrap/cli.php db:entity:fix --dry-run
scripts.db:object:fix: docker-compose -f docker/docker-compose.local.yml run --rm chat-cli-local php backend/Bootstrap/cli.php db:object:fix
scripts.db:object:fix-dry-run: docker-compose -f docker/docker-compose.local.yml run --rm chat-cli-local php backend/Bootstrap/cli.php db:object:fix --dry-run
scripts.db:idea:fix: docker-compose -f docker/docker-compose.local.yml run --rm chat-cli-local php backend/Bootstrap/cli.php db:idea:fix
scripts.db:idea:fix-dry-run: docker-compose -f docker/docker-compose.local.yml run --rm chat-cli-local php backend/Bootstrap/cli.php db:idea:fix --dry-run
scripts.pma: docker-compose -f docker/docker-compose.local.yml up -d phpmyadmin-local && echo phpMyAdmin is running at http://localhost:8080
scripts.frontend-install: docker-compose -f docker/docker-compose.local.yml run --rm chat-frontend-local npm install
scripts.frontend-build: docker-compose -f docker/docker-compose.local.yml run --rm chat-frontend-local npm run build
scripts.test:install-deps: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.test.yml --profile cli run --rm chat-cli-test composer update phpunit/phpunit --no-interaction
scripts.test:db-reset: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.test.yml --profile cli run --rm chat-cli-test php backend/Bootstrap/cli.php db:test:reset
scripts.test:db-wait: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.test.yml --profile cli run --rm chat-cli-test php backend/Bootstrap/cli.php db:wait
scripts.test:unit: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.test.yml --profile cli run --rm chat-cli-test php vendor/bin/phpunit --testsuite unit
scripts.test:integration: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.test.yml --profile cli run --rm chat-cli-test php vendor/bin/phpunit --testsuite integration
scripts.test:phpunit: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.test.yml --profile cli run --rm chat-cli-test php vendor/bin/phpunit
scripts.test:all: composer run test:db-reset && composer run test:phpunit
scripts.test:e2e-up: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.test.yml up -d mysql-test chat-test frontend-test
